header: Five terms you will meet in Desiderio

items.definition: A complete shadcn theme with colour tokens, radius and typography. Desiderio has 15. You can switch them for the whole site or for part of the page tree.
The smallest Fluid 5 component, such as d:atom.button or d:atom.badge. Desiderio has 17 atoms. Molecules, layouts and organisms are built from them.
An element built with TYPO3 Content Blocks 2.2, with its own schema, template and backend preview. Desiderio has 244 of them in 10 groups.
A site setting that scales the spacing of every element: compact for data-heavy sites, relaxed for editorial ones. No template changes are needed.
A theme variable such as background or muted-foreground. Elements only use tokens, so a new preset changes every element at once.
